findings.text: follow-on: resolve() lost both callers when the change split its body into locate_session (:590) and _obligations_view, and no production or test module imports it now, so it is dead on the module's surface.

follow-on: the new-session worker-slots fallback is gated on sessions_present rather than present, so a router that publishes an admission block with no sessions map skips the new-session share and reads the lane-wide worker_slots instead, contrary to the fallback order the function's own docstring names.

follow-on: plan-verifies names only #s3 while the node also implements §11, and evidence-commit names the base 24ea2cb1 rather than the head, so a reader filtering evidence by §11 or by the landed commit does not find this record.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 24ea2cb17; the single commit 64373b684 adds the snapshot-driven stop, the bounded inline derivation, the review-queued reading in obligations.py, the stale-code line and the empty-list header, and updates the shared hook test to publish a snapshot for both modes.
item_verdicts.done_when: six cases in tests/test_stop_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py cover the three stop branches (:220 fresh, :294 over an overridden short budget, :321 in-process cut), the queued reading and its return past the bound (:355), the stale-code line (:431) and the empty-list header (:451); the head arm records 33 passed EXIT=0 and the negative control reds exactly the queued case (1 failed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the stop hook decides from the session's snapshot and reads a lane-refused review duty as queued; reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:825 decides the stop from module.live_payload when the snapshot is FRESH and :792 (_blocking_items) drops the reflex-owned kinds, and reckon/crew/obligations.py:373 raises review-queued from the lane-paused refusal record.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reads status complete, records both gate arms with their revisions, completed true and a literal command, the negative control with its log, and added_failure_count 0 with no ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff 24ea2cb17..64373b684 touches only reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, tests/test_stop_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py, tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py and the plan's evidence fragment, every path inside the declared write paths.

justifications.durability: removing the queued reading at reckon/crew/obligations.py:373 reds the queued case (logs/negative-control.log, 1 failed EXIT=1), and test_a_lane_refused_review_reads_queued_and_returns_after_the_bound:420 re-records the refusal past the bound and asserts review-missing blocks, so the bound is a guard rather than a suppression.
justifications.evidence: the head arm at logs/head-arm-final.log runs the six new cases plus the two kept suites (33 passed, EXIT=0) and the negative control at logs/negative-control.log reds exactly test_a_lane_refused_review_reads_queued_and_returns_after_the_bound, so the gate asserts the done_when and its result is recorded.
justifications.fit: the new names (REVIEW_QUEUED_DUTY_KIND, NON_BLOCKING_DUTY_KINDS, STOP_DERIVATION_BUDGET_SECONDS) carry no plan label or version, and the hook mirrors review-queued as _NON_BLOCKING_KINDS at coordinator_obligations.py:193 because the prompt path may not import the derivation.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:825 decides the stop from module.live_payload whenever the snapshot is FRESH and :792 _blocking_items drops the queued kind so it lists without holding the turn, which is what the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 24ea2cb17..64373b684 lists only the four declared Python paths and the evidence fragment, all inside the fence, and carries no plan-meta edit.
